## bijection_verdict

**PASS.** All atoms of the three extended policies (rules, baselines, all seventeen declared factors' full ladders, both prerequisite sentences, overwrites) and of the base policies they govern correspond at the level of entailment; the retired surface is carried as retired. First revision.

Policy-side notes (not KB verdicts):
- The courtesy overwrite retires the base clause "The credit is goodwill_points_per_credit of the tier held on the credit date", while the extended baseline re-enacts it ("The courtesy tier amount is the goodwill_points_per_credit of the tier held on the credit date, and the standard courtesy credit is that courtesy tier amount"). The KB faithfully carries both — goodwill terms 3 ("The former clause setting the credit at the courtesy points amount of the tier held on the credit date is no longer in force") beside the computation document ("the courtesy credit for a late redemption is that courtesy tier amount"). The juxtaposition reads as a contradiction unless the reader takes "superseded by the current basis" as pointing to the courtesy computation; the tension is the source's choice of superseded clause. The same pattern exists for the milestone clause.
- The milestone dedup ("no quarterly milestone bonus entry dated after the last day of the quarter it is for") means any later milestone entry blocks every earlier quarter; the KB renders it verbatim with a boundary line. It does not bite in this task (only 2026-Q3 is unbooked and nothing is dated after 2026-09-30).
